Usage: workflow <COMMAND>

Commands:
  install  Install standard Kam CI workflows or an upstream release mirror workflow
  help     Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
  -h, --help

zh.build:
构建模块并将其打包为可部署的 ZIP 工件

Usage: build [OPTIONS] [PATH]

Arguments:
  [PATH]
          Path to the project (default: current directory)

          [default: .]
Options:
  -a, --all
          Build all workspace members

  -o, --output <OUTPUT>
          Output directory (default: dist)

  -b, --bump
          Enable `KAM_BUMP_ENABLED` environment variable (set to 1)

  -r, --release
          Enable `KAM_RELEASE_ENABLED` environment variable (set to 1)

  -s, --sign
          Enable `KAM_SIGN_ENABLE` environment variable (set to 1)

  -i, --interactive
          Run build interactively; ask for confirmation when performing potentially destructive actions

  -P, --pre-release
          Enable `KAM_PRE_RELEASE` environment variable (set to 1)

  -q, --quiet
          Suppress most output; show only warnings and errors

  -j, --jobs <JOBS>
          Number of parallel jobs (default: number of CPU cores)

  -h, --help
          Print help (see a summary with '-h')

Usage: cache <COMMAND>

Commands:
  list       List cached templates
  clean      Clean all cached templates
  add        Add a template to cache from a local directory or archive
  remove     Remove a template from cache
  path       Show cache directory path
  templates  Manage template cache entries
  modules    Manage module index cache (index_*.json and modules/<id>.json)

zh.check:
对项目的 JSON/YAML/Markdown 文件进行 lint/格式/解析 检查

Arguments:
  [PATHS]...
          Paths or globs to check (file(s), directories, or glob patterns). If omitted, `path` (project directory) will be checked
Options:
      --project-path <PATH>
          Path to use as project directory fallback when no PATHS are supplied (default: current directory). Use positional PATHS for files/globs

          [default: .]

      --json
          Output results as JSON (compact by default; use -v/--verbose for detailed JSON)

  -v, --verbose
          Verbose JSON output (include full results). When using --json, this enables detailed output

      --fix
          Try to automatically fix/format files

      --fail-on-error
          Return a non-zero exit status when any errors are found (useful for CI)

      --fail-on-warning
          Return a non-zero exit status when any warnings are present (in addition to errors)

zh.kam:
kam — Kam 是一款用于搭建、构建、打包与分发安卓模块与模板的命令行工具（KernelSU/APU/Magisk/AnyKernel3/AnyTemplate）。它支持项目初始化、打包构建、模板管理、仓库搜索/下载，以及导出各种元数据文件。

Usage: kam [OPTIONS] [-- [TARGETS]...] [COMMAND]

Commands:
  init         从模板初始化新项目
  build        构建并打包模块
  version      管理模块版本与升级策略
  cache        管理本地缓存
  tmpl         模板管理（导入/导出/打包/列出） [aliases: template, templates]
  validate     验证 kam.toml 与模板
  completions  生成 shell 补全脚本 [aliases: completion]
  secret       密钥环与证书管理
  sign         对工件进行签名
  verify       验证签名
  check        校验项目文件
  export       导出各种元数据文件
  toml         查看与编辑 kam.toml
  config       管理 Kam 配置
  install      兼容安装层
  publish      发布构建产物到 GitHub Release
  workflow     安装用于构建与发布自动化的 GitHub Actions 工作流
  repo         仓库搜索与下载
  about        显示 Kam 的信息与致谢
  env          打印 KAM_ 相关环境变量
  help         显示帮助信息
zh.publish:
将构建输出目录中的模块 ZIP 与旁路产物发布到 GitHub Release。

Usage: publish [OPTIONS]

Options:
  -R, --repo <REPO>
          Target GitHub repository in owner/repo format. Defaults to GITHUB_REPOSITORY, KAM_RELEASE_REPO, or git origin

      --tag <TAG>
          Release tag. Defaults to KAM_RELEASE_TAG or the module version in kam.toml

      --dist <DIST>
          Build output directory containing release assets

          [default: dist]

  -t, --title <TITLE>
          Release title. Defaults to <module-id>-<versionCode>-<version>

  -n, --notes <NOTES>
          Release notes text

  -F, --notes-file <NOTES_FILE>
          Read release notes from a file

  -p, --prerelease
          Mark the release as a prerelease

  -d, --draft
          Keep the release as a draft instead of publishing it

      --all-assets
          Upload every file in --dist. By default only module ZIPs and their sidecar files are uploaded

      --dry-run
          Print the gh commands without executing them

  -h, --help
          Print help (see a summary with '-h')
zh.repo:

Usage: repo [OPTIONS] [TARGETS]... [COMMAND]

Commands:
  sync      Sync (refresh) the index cache from remote (similar to pacman -Sy)
  search    Search the module repository
  download  Download one or more modules from the repository
  help      Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Arguments:
  [TARGETS]...
          Positional targets: module IDs or search terms (used with -S / -s)
Options:
  -S, --sync
          Pacman-style sync (download) flag (equivalent to pacman -S)

  -s, --search
          Pacman-style search modifier (use with -S as '-Ss' to search or '-s' alone to search)

  -q, --quiet
          Suppress progress output (quiet mode)

  -h, --help
          Print help (see a summary with '-h')
zh.secret:
管理用于签名/验证的密钥与证书

Usage: secret [OPTIONS] [COMMAND]

Commands:
  list          List saved secrets
  add           Add a secret from a value or file
  get           Get a secret and print it to stdout (or --out file)
  remove        Remove a secret
  export        Export secret to a file (by default decrypted). Use --encrypted to export encrypted blob
  import        Import secret from a file. If file is an encrypted KAM blob, it will be stored as-is
  export-pub    Export public key from a stored private key secret
  import-cert   Import developer certificate chain from GitHub issue or file
  trust         Manage trusted Root CAs
  ksu-generate  Generate a KernelSU developer P-256 key pair for developers.kernelsu.org
  ksu-submit    Create the KernelSU developer public-key submission issue URL
  ksu-revoke    Create the KernelSU developer certificate revocation issue URL
  help          Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
  -i, --interactive
          Interactive mode: guide the user through secret management (add/list/get/remove, etc.)

  -h, --help
          Print help (see a summary with '-h')
zh.sign:

Usage: sign [OPTIONS] [SRC]

Arguments:
  [SRC]
          The artifact to sign (zip). If omitted, use --dist or --all to sign multiple files
Options:
      --secret <SECRET>
          Name of the secret in kam keyring that holds the private key

          [default: main]

      --out <OUT>
          Output directory (default: dist)

          [default: dist]

      --dist <DIR>
          Sign all artifacts in given directory (instead of specifying single src file)

      --all
          Sign all artifacts inside dist (alias of --dist <dir> with default dist)

      --cert <CERT>
          Certificate PEM chain path to include in signature metadata

      --key-path <KEY_PATH>
          Optional path to a private key PEM file to use instead of the keyring secret

  -h, --help
          Print help (see a summary with '-h')

zh.verify:
验证 .sig 或 sigstore（DSSE）签名包

Usage: verify [OPTIONS] [SRC]

Arguments:
  [SRC]
          Path to the artifact to verify (required for .sig verification)
Options:
      --sig <SIG>
          Path to signature file (base64 .sig). If omitted, defaults to <src>.sig

      --bundle <BUNDLE>
          Path to .sigstore.json bundle containing DSSE envelope and certs

      --cert <CERT>
          Optional certificate PEM to use for verification (overrides bundle cert)

      --root <ROOT>
          Optional root CA PEM to verify a certificate chain (trusted anchor)

      --secret <SECRET>
          Name of secret in kam keyring that holds the private key; used to derive public key for verification

          [default: main]

      --key <KEY>
          Path to public key PEM for verification (overrides derived key from secret)

      --cert-name <CERT_NAME>
          Name of cached developer certificate to use for verification

      --cert-chain <CERT_CHAIN>
          Path to certificate chain PEM file for verification

      --skip-crl

  -v, --verbose
